newsitem.title: USA: Melville August same-store sales rose 8.7.
newsitem.headline: Melville August same-store sales rose 8.7.

text.p: Melville Corp said Thursday that same-store sales for the four weeks ended August 31 increased 8.7 percent over the prior-year period.
Consolidated retail store sales for the four weeks decreased 23.4 percent, to $719.3 million from $939.0 million.

Same-store sales for the 34-week, six-day year-to-date period increased 6.9 percent over a year earlier, it said. Consolidated retail store sales were $5.83 billion, a decrease of 18.8 percent from $7.18 billion for a year earlier. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
